definitions.explanation: Indicates that a registration process has been completed. Used for accounts, products, documents, and any official registration. Functions as a no-adjective to modify nouns.

examples.japanese: {登録済|とうろくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アカウント→アカウント：05103_akaunto⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商標|しょうひょう}→商標：12019_shouhyou⟧{登録済|とうろくず}みです。
⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{登録済|とうろくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ログインして→ログインする：23297_roguinsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have already completed member registration, please log in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{登録済|とうろくず}みです⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ご⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The address change notification has been registered, so please rest assured.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ (registration) + {済|す}み (completed). The suffix {済|す}み attaches to nouns (especially suru-verb stems) to indicate that the action has been finished. This pattern is extremely productive:
- ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧{済|す}み: confirmed/verified
- {支払|しはら}い{済|す}み: paid
- ⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧{済|す}み: completed
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{済|す}み: reserved/booked

Very common in business, administrative, and digital contexts (websites, apps, forms).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登録済|とうろくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: registered address
- {登録済|とうろくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メールアドレス→メールアドレス：23540_meeruadoresu⟧: registered email address
- ⟦{商標|しょうひょう}→商標：12019_shouhyou⟧{登録済|とうろくず}み: trademark registered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: registration complete — more explicit phrasing, common in system messages
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧{済|す}み: notification filed — similar pattern with a different action
